capture_rule: Capture every byte and every compound, citation, dataset, property, variable, constraint, phase, method, uncertainty and point from each complete NIST ThermoML source. Construct three post-seal coupled evidence surfaces: every direct Soret and mass-diffusion record in the mass-heat source; every direct electrical-conductivity and tracer-diffusion record in the mass-charge source; and every direct thermal-conductivity and electrical-conductivity record in the heat-charge source. Preserve every companion property and dataset but exclude it from the coupled measurements. Do not select substances, mixtures, phases, compositions, temperatures, pressures, methods, datasets, properties or rows within a source.
source_selection_boundary: The three complete authoritative sources are fixed before any measured value, uncertainty or target hash is captured and before executable-law registration, candidate enumeration or prediction-program construction. Selection is by complementary carrier topology only: one complete mass-heat source, one complete mass-charge source and one complete heat-charge source. Together they test every pair of the mass, heat and charge carrier triad without using a result value.
